page.overview:
Who is Melavaire Someinellin?

Melavaire Someinellin is an Aes Sedai of the Gray Ajah.

Melavaire is a stout, short Cairhienin (inches shorter than Egwene), with flecks of white in her dark hair.

She was kindly, but could be fearsome when angry.

She is likely to be more than 150 years old as she has streaks of white in her hair, a sign of extreme age in an Aes Sedai.
